angle: Which products are genuinely worth their current price — and which to skip.

reviews.title: Mr Coffee Cup Mini Brew
pros: Grab-a-cup auto pause lets you pour mid-brew without dripping on the hot plate
Compact footprint (about 10.8 x 7.4 x 10.2 inches) fits under most upper cabinets
Simple rocker switch operation — no digital clock to program or buttons to decipher

reviews.title: Skullcandy Jib Wired Earbuds
pros: Flat tangle-free cable actually survives daily desk abuse and pocket stuffing
Inline mic with single-button control works for calls and music on both Android and iOS
Supreme bass tuning makes podcasts and conference calls sound fuller than $9 has any right to
